text: Q.	The WSJ headline (with no blackout) is from their print edition. It says that Trump is asking allies to help escorts ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The headline from Forbes is after his press conference today. What is Trump now saying? ‎image omitted
Or is he saying we don’t need anybody?
Now that allies have said, “this is not our war, we didn’t start it,” he is saying, “OK we don’t need anybody, but lots of others will help anyway.”
